svg.title: Nomos request lifecycle
svg.text: Each action is judged against the agent's own context. Nothing runs until Nomos approves it; the executor runs only what was signed, then signs what happened.
action scopes vs. the account's role
deterministic rules · fails closed if unreachable
sets risk level and the approval threshold
does the action fit the agent's task? unanimous by default
Ed25519 · lifetime 30–300 s, shorter for higher risk
packaged files, then the exact command
success or rejection, executor's own key
a revision is a new request
the exact string that will run
where it runs, on the executor
the only agent that may use it
receipt attached to the next request
trust boundary; each side checks the other
Steps 5 and 6 run concurrently in the shipped config.
Steps 8–10 run on every Writ. A council-approved command
can still be refused at step 10, and its Writ is then spent.
HTTP 200 alone is not success: read success and stage.
